# Modular Pipelines Documentation

> Documentation for ModularPipelines - a C# framework for building modular, testable CI/CD pipelines with dependency injection support.


## ModularPipelines

- [Search the documentation](/search.md)
- [Modular Pipelines](/docs.md): About
- [Analyzer rules](/docs/analyzers.md): | Rule | Category | Default severity | Availability | Description |
- [MP0001](/docs/analyzers/MP0001.md): Accesses a module result without declaring the dependency.
- [MP0002](/docs/analyzers/MP0002.md): Uses IEnumerable as a module result instead of a concrete collection.
- [MP0003](/docs/analyzers/MP0003.md): Injects a logger into a module constructor instead of using the module context.
- [MP0004](/docs/analyzers/MP0004.md): Writes directly to System.Console instead of using pipeline logging.
- [MP0005](/docs/analyzers/MP0005.md): Creates a circular dependency between modules.
- [MP0006](/docs/analyzers/MP0006.md): Implements ExecuteAsync without the async modifier.
- [MP0007](/docs/analyzers/MP0007.md): Awaits the current module instance.
- [MP0008](/docs/analyzers/MP0008.md): Declares mutable instance state that can leak between module executions.
- [MP0009](/docs/analyzers/MP0009.md): References a dependency type that does not implement IModule.
- [MP0010](/docs/analyzers/MP0010.md): Declares a module dependency on itself.
- [MP0011](/docs/analyzers/MP0011.md): Requires generated CLI option properties to be virtual.
- [MP0012](/docs/analyzers/MP0012.md): Requires generated CLI command methods to be virtual.
- [MP0013](/docs/analyzers/MP0013.md): Module is not registered with the pipeline.
- [MP0014](/docs/analyzers/MP0014.md): Async void method in a module.
- [MP0015](/docs/analyzers/MP0015.md): Blocking call in ExecuteAsync.
- [MP0016](/docs/analyzers/MP0016.md): ExecuteAsync cancellation token is not flowed.
- [MP0017](/docs/analyzers/MP0017.md): Thread.Sleep in ExecuteAsync.
- [MP0018](/docs/analyzers/MP0018.md): Module class is not public.
- [MP0019](/docs/analyzers/MP0019.md): Duplicate DependsOn declaration.
- [MP0020](/docs/analyzers/MP0020.md): Repeated WithSkipWhen calls on one module configuration builder are OR-ed.
- [MPCLI001](/docs/analyzers/MPCLI001.md): CliFlag property must be bool? or int?
- [MPCLI002](/docs/analyzers/MPCLI002.md): Value-less bool? CliOption should use CliFlag.
- [MPCLI003](/docs/analyzers/MPCLI003.md): Multiple CLI attributes applied to one property.
- [MPCLI004](/docs/analyzers/MPCLI004.md): Duplicate CLI switch in an options hierarchy.
- [MPCLI005](/docs/analyzers/MPCLI005.md): Negated CLI flag applied to a non-nullable-Boolean or counted property.
- [MPCLI006](/docs/analyzers/MPCLI006.md): CLI attributes used outside CommandLineToolOptions.

Instead of running every module in a single process, work is divided between a master that orchestrates and one or more workers that execute modules.
